cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Sell the Disaster
cards.instruction: Make a terrible plan sound sensible, responsible, and inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've authorized an advance of our auction takings to the charity. Borrowing the five thousand showed commitment.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we cancel the auction? Only your mum registered.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cancellation is not approved. One bidder keeps catering costs down. Responsible fundraising.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's only coming to give us a lift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I authorize us to bid. Raise the card limit; we must protect the donation by replacing the money we borrowed to make it.

reason: Rereading found that making the charity depend on a lift confused transport with the financial shortfall. State A circular borrowing justification directly, caused by B revelation that there is no genuine bidder.
